dedupe_keys.name: a comprehensive database of active and potentially active continental faults in chile at 1 25 000 scale

description: A comprehensive database of active and potentially-active continental faults in Chile at 1:25,000 scale is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Valentina Maldonado et al. In seismically-active regions, mapping active and potentially-active faults is the first step to assess seismic hazards and site selection for paleoseismic studies that will estimate recurrence rates. Coverage: national (CL); published in 2021. Formats: Excel, Shapefile. The data are held in PANGAEA and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 6 data points. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
